rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when clarifying an idea by giving an example or comparison.

example.english: I use a simple story to illustrate this concept.
example.traditional: 我用個簡單故事用例子解釋呢個概念。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 go3 gaan2 daan1 gu3 si6 jung6 lai6 zi2 gaai2 sik1 ni1 go3 koi3 nim6

rows.note: Use this specifically when adding pictures, diagrams, or other visuals to a book, article, or publication.

example.english: The publisher asked an artist to illustrate this book.
example.traditional: 出版社請畫家為本書配圖。
example.jyutping: ceot1 baan2 se5 cing2 waa2 gaa1 wai4 bun2 syu1 pui3 tou4
